source.title: Chen et al. (2023), TSMixer: An All-MLP Architecture for Time Series Forecasting

paper_assessment: The paper alternates residual mixing across time and features, sharing temporal weights across channels and feature weights across times. Its basic temporal branch uses one dense layer; feature mixing uses two. The paper includes different normalization and auxiliary-feature alignment designs and evaluates forecasting, including retail demand. These results motivate a competing architecture; they do not establish hydropower commitment accuracy or micro-AUC gains.

adaptation.label: TSMixer-inspired adaptation, not a paper benchmark replication
adaptation.input: Batch x 306 supplied feature channels x 168 hours
adaptation.time_branch: Pre-LayerNorm over 64 latent channels; transpose; dense 168 to 168, GELU, dropout 0.1, dense 168 to 168, dropout 0.1; residual
adaptation.channel_branch: Pre-LayerNorm over 64 latent channels; dense 64 to 128, GELU, dropout 0.1, dense 128 to 64, dropout 0.1; residual
adaptation.output: Final LayerNorm; per-hour dense 64 to 14 logits; transpose to batch x generator x hour
adaptation.differences_from_paper: Two-layer temporal MLP, per-hour channel LayerNorm, GELU, fixed same-week output horizon and binary labels. No historical target-series input, forecast projection, auxiliary alignment subnetwork, or paper-specific benchmark training recipe.
adaptation.positions: Time-mixing matrices depend on absolute horizon positions; no extra learned positional embeddings.
adaptation.causality: Noncausal full-week mixing is valid because the complete supplied input horizon is available. No labels or future unprovided state are inputs.

control_protocol.training: Identical features, economic rescaling, training-only stable scaler, chronological six-case purge, AdamW LR0.001, weight_decay0.0001 default, seed42, batch32, CPU four threads, BCE and clipping1.0. Architecture is the sole model change.
control_protocol.budget: 39 epochs; patience40 prevents early termination within that budget; retain checkpoint with best current frozen-ensemble micro-AUC. This is budget-matched but validation-selected, not fixed final-checkpoint selection.
control_protocol.2022_template: configs/round2_mixer_2022.json uses fixed mode with no monitor or scheduler. Its placeholder39 epochs must be replaced by the chosen 2021 best_epoch before any confirmation fit. Freeze blend replacement/averaging choice on2021 first.
control_protocol.final_export: Neural agent owns train/export model-map integration. For full fit, use the selected epoch/architecture/features and preserve the exact frozen blend recipe.

why_it_might_help: Time mixing gives every hourly prediction direct whole-week context using position-specific shared weights rather than input-dependent attention.
A different representation may fit weekly commitment patterns or produce complementary errors under the existing blend.
It tests a model-family hypothesis with current features fixed, avoiding another round of feature accumulation.
why_it_might_fail: Hydraulic allocation depends on case-specific relationships between price peaks, storage and constraints; static temporal mixing may be less adaptive than attention.
Daily overlapping cases provide fewer independent examples than the raw hourly-output count suggests; temporal dense matrices can memorize horizon-specific patterns.
This version has more parameters than the current small Transformer, so reduced overfitting is not guaranteed by its MLP design.
The chosen width, activation and normalization are adaptations; the original paper does not validate these exact choices.
Fixed current blend weights may underuse a strong Mixer at some plants; tuning new weights immediately would confound the controlled architecture test.
Benchmark forecasting gains need not transfer to simultaneous full-week ON/OFF labeling or pooled ranking.
validation_limits: 2021 checkpoint selection is optimistic after repeated development and multiple candidates.
2022 is reused historical confirmation, not a pristine holdout; baseline components can themselves be2022-selected.
Report all2022cases plus Jan7 onward to exclude six starts overlapping2021selection-label horizons; that purge does not erase earlier model-selection reuse.
Same39epoch budget does not imply equal wall time, parameter count or optimizer trajectory.
